name: Vedanta Power Limited
remarksWeb: I. 2,98,632 shares are under abeyance category, pending for allotment as they are subjudice and hence, does not form part of the listed share capital.  II. As per Regulation 3(5) of the SEBl(Share based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021 the voting rights of Vedanta Limited ESOS Trust are reserved.  III. - Vedanta Power Limited (formerly known as Talwandi Sabo Power Limited) is a majority-owned and controlled subsidiary of Vedanta Resources Limited (VRL). Vedanta Incorporated ('Vedanta Inc.') (Erstwhile Volcan Investments Limited) and its subsidiary hold 100.0% of the share capital and 100.0% of the voting rights of VRL. Vedanta Inc. is a holding company, 100.0% beneficially owned and controlled by the Anil Agarwal Discretionary Trust (Trust). Conclave PTC Limited (Conclave) is the trustee of the Trust and the sole registered shareholder of Vedanta Inc. VRLs  shares are beneficially owned by Vedanta Inc. which may be deemed to be beneficially owned by the Trust, of which Mr. Anil Agarwal is the protector and with effect from October 16, 2014, one of the beneficiaries.
